$description: Frame manifest for the OCA account_asset_management 19.0 visual review. Each entry maps onto one Penpot page with the captured screenshot embedded as a frame and the annotation rendered as a sticky note. See ./README.md for context (PR #2293 migration) and ./scripts/bootstrap-penpot.mjs for the consumer.

pages.name: 1 · Assets — list

frames.label: 19.0 — list view across states (5 demo assets)

pages.annotation: Status badges (Draft / Running) render via the `state` widget. Three numeric columns (Depreciation Base, Depreciated, Residual Value) compete for attention — design opportunity to consolidate into one progress bar per row.

pages.name: 2 · Asset — form (open)
pages.annotation: Top sheet shows purchase value + profile + dates. Notebook below contains the depreciation lines and accounting moves. Audit Log: status badge top-right, set-to-draft button left of state widget.

pages.name: 3 · Asset — depreciation board
pages.annotation: Per-period rows with date / amount / move-state. Move-check column shows green/red dot. Design eye: consider freezing the table header on scroll; current implementation re-mounts on long boards.

pages.name: 4 · Asset Profiles — list
pages.annotation: Profile = template for new assets. Method + period + duration columns. Wide enough to benefit from a kanban variant grouped by method (linear/degressive).

pages.name: 5 · Asset Profile — form

frames.label: 19.0 — profile detail with accounting + method config

pages.annotation: Three accounts (asset / depreciation / expense) plus journal + method. Long form — design opportunity: collapse accounting fields into a 'Posting' section that defaults to sensible values per chart-of-accounts.

pages.name: 6 · Compute Depreciation wizard
pages.annotation: Wizard drives the month-end / year-end depreciation run. Currently single screen — design audit: does it explain WHAT will happen on submit? Add a preview-count of journal entries that will be created.

pages.name: 7 · Asset Report wizard (XLS)
pages.annotation: Filters: date range, asset profiles, groups. Outputs XLS via report_xlsx_helper. Design eye: filter UX feels like an old-style modal — consider porting to the standard search-and-export pattern on the asset list itself.

pages.name: 8 · Asset Groups
pages.annotation: Hierarchical tags for cross-cutting categorization (e.g. 'Plant & Equipment', 'Vehicles → Fleet'). Empty in demo because we didn't seed any. Worth a small starter set in the module's seeded data.
